Initialisers for parameters

Source: R/init.R
zl_init_normal.Rd

Each returns a description of how zl_param() fills a new parameter. Random draws come from 'zurand' under a key derived from the session key and the parameter's name, so they do not depend on the order in which parameters are declared, and adding a parameter does not change the values of the others.

Usage

zl_init_normal(sd = 0.02)

zl_init_uniform(a)

zl_init_zeros()

zl_init_ones()

Arguments

sd

Standard deviation of a normal distribution with mean zero.

a

Half-width of a uniform distribution on (-a, a).

Value

An object of class zl_init.

Examples

p <- zl_params()
zl_param(p, "w", c(4, 3), init = zl_init_normal(sd = 0.1))
zl_param(p, "b", 3, init = zl_init_zeros())
zl_param_get(p, "b")
#> [1] 0 0 0
